resources.string: Designed for anonymity and end-to-end encryption – without ads, tracking or own servers. Relays, media and STUN servers are replaceable defaults operated by independent third parties; for technical reasons they can see e.g. your IP address. No independent security audit, no warranty – use at your own risk. Everyone is responsible for their own use and content.
I accept the terms of use, have read the privacy notice and am responsible for my own use and content.
Off: messages arrive while the app is open or briefly in the background.
On: messages and calls arrive even when the app is closed. Uses some battery.
Conversa then stays connected to the relays. Messages and calls arrive immediately – even when the app is closed or the phone is in standby. No Google service is used.

🔋 Battery: this uses extra power, roughly an estimated 1–5 % per day. The exact amount depends on the phone, the network (Wi-Fi uses less than mobile data) and the number of messages. Reason: the phone briefly checks every few minutes whether the connection is still up.
Android shows a permanent notice in the notification bar for this. You can hide it in the system settings. With Tor, Orbot must also run in the background.
Tip: some phones (e.g. Xiaomi, Huawei, Samsung) still kill apps in the background. Exempting Conversa from battery optimization helps.
The chat will be removed. Further messages, calls and requests from this sender will be ignored. They will not be notified. You can undo this under Settings → Blocked.
Calls are possible after you accept.
Calls are direct (P2P). Without a TURN server, the other person can see your IP address.
Permanent notice while Conversa stays connected in the background. Can be hidden.

All messages of this chat and cached images, videos and voice messages will be permanently removed from your devices and will not come back after logging in again. The other person keeps their copy of the chat. Only encrypted copies remain on the relays, which nobody but the two of you can read.
The contact and the local history will be removed.
“Delete for everyone” also removes the message for the recipient (Conversa 1.3 or newer). If they have already seen it, they may still have copied it or taken a screenshot.
The message will be removed from your devices. The other person keeps their copy.
Enter the code from Google Authenticator.
Account data could not be read

File not available or tampered with
A group can have at most %1$d members.
This group change is not allowed.

The file will be decrypted and saved to a location of your choice. Conversa does not open it. Only open files if you trust the sender – apps (.apk), documents with macros and scripts in particular can be harmful.

This file comes from an unknown sender. When downloading, their media server learns your IP address. The file will be decrypted and saved to a location of your choice; Conversa does not open it. Only open it if you trust the sender.
You become creator and admin. Invited people must confirm joining first. At most 32 members. Everyone needs Conversa 1.4 or newer.
The group will be deleted for all members whose Conversa receives the deletion. Copies others have already saved or photographed, and encrypted data on the relays, cannot be guaranteed to be removed.

You created this group. Deleting removes it for all members whose Conversa receives the deletion. Copies others have already saved or photographed, and encrypted data on the relays, cannot be guaranteed to be removed.
The chat will be removed from your devices and will not come back after logging in again.
Invited people first see a notice and must confirm joining. They cannot read earlier messages of the group.

By joining, you cannot delete the contents of this chat for the others – not even your own messages. Only the group admins can delete for everyone, by deleting the whole group. You can leave the chat at any time and remove it from your devices.\n\nHonest note: in a decentralized network it cannot be guaranteed that deleted messages really disappear everywhere. Members can save or photograph content beforehand, and encrypted copies may remain on relays. All current members can see your messages.
You leave the group and the chat is removed from your devices. The other members keep the messages – including yours.
More user IDs (npub1…, one per line)

From now on, this person will not receive new messages from this group: every message is encrypted individually for the current members, there is no shared key. What they have received so far stays on their devices.
You are no longer a member
You are no longer a member of this group. You will not receive new messages and cannot send anything. The previous history stays on your device until you delete the chat.
The new name is visible to all members (end-to-end encrypted).
You are an admin of this group.
You are the creator and an admin of this group.
You are a member of this group.
You are no longer a member of this group.

🔒 Every message is end-to-end encrypted individually for each current member (NIP-17/NIP-44). Relays see no group and no member list. Changes to members and rights are signed by an admin and checked by every device. Limits: new members trust the inviting admin’s member list when joining; the sender sets the time of a message; deleted content cannot be guaranteed to be removed from all devices and relays.
– your device clock is off by %1$d s (compensated)
– network time not available yet, please wait a moment and try again

🎤 Load voice message from unknown sender

No server, no email, no phone number. Your secret key is computed only on this device from username + password. You log in on any device with the same credentials.\n\n⚠ The password cannot be reset. If you lose it, the account is lost. Choose a long, unique password.
All local data will be securely deleted. Chats and contacts can be restored from the network with your username + password as long as the relays keep them.
No contacts yet.\nShare your ID (Settings) or add a contact with “+”.
Connected to the relays. Can be turned off in the settings.
Conversa is receiving in the background
Tap to open Conversa and answer
Conversa uses open-source software. Tap an entry to read the full text.
At least 3 of: lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, special characters
Mutual, like in other messengers: if it is off, you also won’t see whether others have read your messages. Read receipts are never sent to message requests.
Nostr relays (one wss:// URL per line)
Only visible on this device. The name is not sent – neither to relays nor to anyone else. Leave empty for the original name.
Point the camera at the QR code of the contact ID (Settings → Your contact ID). The image is only analyzed on this device.
Spam protection: at most %1$d open message requests with %2$d messages each are accepted.
Calls do not go through Tor. Without your own TURN server (Settings → Calls), the other person and the STUN servers (Google, Cloudflare) can see your real IP address.
Not active. Adds extra protection to your account with Google Authenticator.
✓ Active – a code is required at login and app start.
1. Open Google Authenticator → “+” → “Scan a QR code”.
2. Enter the displayed code to finish the setup.
Connect via Tor (Orbot must be running, SOCKS 9050)
Share this ID so others can add you. It reveals nothing about you.
